boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Linfield options with university-published no-cost or free-access evidence.

cards.title: Browse the Linfield Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Miller Fine Arts Center, McMinnville campus
cards.notes: Drop in during published gallery hours, move through the current exhibition together, and use the work as an easy conversation starter.
cards.short_summary: A rotating campus gallery with free public admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield states that its gallery exhibits are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday noon–5 p.m.; the university provides directions and notes street/lot parking.

cards.title: Work through a class with a tutor
cards.subtitle: Learning Support Services, McMinnville
cards.notes: Request an individual session for a course, then bring a focused question or problem set to make the time practical and collaborative.
cards.short_summary: One-on-one academic support for currently enrolled students.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield says individual tutoring has no cost and may be used for multiple classes when a tutor is available.
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on a tutor match; McMinnville students should first attend existing departmental drop-in tutoring.

cards.title: Bring a question to drop-in tutoring
cards.subtitle: McMinnville campus academic departments
cards.notes: Check the student-only tutoring schedule, arrive with a specific assignment question, and compare approaches with classmates working on the same material.
cards.short_summary: Department-run, no-cost help sessions for course work.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield states that many departments offer free drop-in tutoring for a variety of classes.
cards.access_notes: Current times, locations, and departments are in a document accessible only to current students.

cards.title: Make time for a counseling visit
cards.subtitle: Student Health, Wellness and Counseling Center
cards.notes: Use a private appointment when you want space to talk through stress or a concern; the service is intended for enrolled in-person students.
cards.short_summary: Confidential, no-cost counseling access for eligible Linfield students.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield says currently enrolled undergraduate and graduate in-person students have counseling access at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Available to enrolled students in in-person classes on the McMinnville or Portland campus; it is not a public drop-in venue.

cards.title: Spend time in the campus garden
cards.subtitle: Next to Renshaw Hall, McMinnville campus
cards.notes: Visit the garden beside Renshaw Hall, notice what is growing, and connect with the garden community if you want to help cultivate plants.
cards.short_summary: A campus garden for hands-on time outdoors.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield identifies the McMinnville campus garden next to Renshaw Hall and invites students to cultivate plants and join its garden community.
cards.access_notes: Coordinate with the garden community before planting or taking part in cultivation; no admission or purchase is listed.

cards.title: Set up a zero-waste student gathering
cards.subtitle: ASLU Preserveware; return dishes to Dillin Hall
cards.notes: For a student activity, reserve reusable cups, plates, and flatware, then return the dishes to Dillin Hall after the gathering.
cards.short_summary: No-cost reusable serving ware for student activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield says ASLU maintains McMinnville Preserveware for student activities and events at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through 25Live and return dishes to Dillin Hall for cleaning; intended for student activities and events.

cards.title: Settle into Nicholson Library
cards.subtitle: Library Court, McMinnville campus
cards.notes: Bring your Linfield ID, choose a table or resource for a low-key study session, and check with library staff for available services.
cards.short_summary: A named campus library accessible with the university’s free student ID.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield states that students receive an initial ID card free of charge and need it to use the library.
cards.access_notes: For Linfield students: carry the issued student ID. The current campus map lists Jereld R. Nicholson Library on Library Court.

cards.title: Use a campus computer lab
cards.subtitle: McMinnville campus; student ID access
cards.notes: Use your issued ID to access a computer lab when you need a change of study setting, shared screens, or campus technology.
cards.short_summary: Student computer-lab access tied to Linfield’s free initial ID card.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield states that students receive an initial ID card free of charge and need it to use a computer lab.
cards.access_notes: For Linfield students with a current ID; the university’s campus map identifies a computer lab in Renshaw Hall.

cards.entity_name: Health, Human Performance and Athletics Building
cards.title: Use the HHPA building
cards.subtitle: McMinnville campus; student ID access
cards.notes: Bring your Linfield ID and use the building as an on-campus activity setting; confirm the particular space’s availability before organizing a group.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed athletics building available through student-ID access.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield states that students receive an initial ID card free of charge and need it to use HHPA.
cards.access_notes: For Linfield students with a current ID; the campus map names the Health, Human Performance and Athletics Building and Ted Wilson Gymnasium.

cards.title: Meet up at the Recreation Complex
cards.subtitle: McMinnville campus; student ID access
cards.notes: Bring your Linfield ID, check what space is open, and plan a casual, active meet-up that fits the posted facility expectations.
cards.short_summary: A student-access recreation destination on the McMinnville campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield states that students receive an initial ID card free of charge and need it to use the Recreation Complex.
cards.access_notes: For Linfield students with a current ID; verify space availability and any activity-specific rules with the facility.
